name: .NET
description: Install and update .NET SDKs by channel or version, with workloads

channel.label: Release channel
channel.help: lts takes the newest SDK with long-term support, sts the newest with standard-term support, latest the newest released SDK of all; a channel such as 10.0 the newest SDK of that channel.

metadataUrl.label: Release metadata
metadataUrl.help: releases-index.json of the .NET release metadata. The releases.json of a channel is expected next to it in CHANNEL/releases.json. Change it to use a mirror in the own network.

installScriptUrl.label: Install script
installScriptUrl.help: Address of dotnet-install.sh, which downloads and unpacks the SDKs.

feedUrl.label: Download server
feedUrl.help: Server with the SDK archives (layout of builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet), handed to the install script. Change it to use a mirror in the own network.

installDir.label: Install location
installDir.help: All SDKs share this directory; it becomes DOTNET_ROOT.

keepPatches.label: SDK versions to keep per channel

workloads.label: Workloads
workloads.help: Workload IDs installed with dotnet workload install into the newest SDK, e.g. wasm-tools.

envFile.label: Shell environment file
envFile.help: Sets DOTNET_ROOT and puts dotnet in PATH of new shells.

version.label: Version
version.help: Channel (10.0), SDK version (10.0.100), lts, sts or latest. Empty follows the settings.

remove.label: Remove .NET SDK
remove.confirm: The .NET SDK is deleted together with runtimes no other SDK uses. Projects that rely on it need another one afterwards.
